title: status's 'Hollows rested: 3/9' tracker (and the milestone line 'Three hollows rested: the pilgrim stair at Coldpass opens for you') counts the Meres, which I resolved via the explicitly-labeled 'swear to carry the covenant (settles this hold's grief: a bargain: quieter, not rested)' option, as one of the three 'rested' holds -- contradicting the separate 'Hollows bargained: 1/9' tracker that correctly logs it as a bargain, not a rest.
